title: I built a mini AI hedge fund that learns from every trade, every veto, and every other trader using it
author: andrew363601

replies.author: andrew363601
replies.body: Thank you, did a TON of competitor research before even coding, so I identified the gaps in the market compared to services currently available- real edge if you tried to stack it against any top sites. IMO at least lol for now I got 1 asset trading LIVE. Over the next few days we'll see how things perform with the recent updates.
